Initial release of the ModelsLab agent skills.

- Provides official agent skills for ModelsLab's comprehensive AI API platform.
- Enables image, video, audio, 3D, deepfake, and interior design AI generation.
- Adds account management, billing, model discovery, webhooks, and SDK usage skills.
- Includes installation instructions and example usage prompts.
- Links to documentation, dashboard, and support resources.
